description: This file defines default stub implementations for the torch profiler, including registration mechanisms for different profiling backends such as CUDA, ITT, and PrivateUse1. It contains class definitions, method implementations, and macro-based registration logic.

classes.name: DefaultStubs
classes.description: A default implementation of ProfilerStubs that fails on all method calls unless overridden.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Stub method for recording profiling data, triggers fail() if called.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Stub method for calculating elapsed time, triggers fail() if called.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Stub method for marking a profiling point, triggers fail() if called.

methods.name: rangePush
methods.description: Stub method for pushing a profiling range, triggers fail() if called.

methods.name: rangePop
methods.description: Stub method for popping a profiling range, triggers fail() if called.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Returns false indicating profiling is not enabled in default stubs.

methods.name: onEachDevice

methods.description: Stub method for synchronization, triggers fail() if called.
